issue.title: test_pre_existing_sibling_file_is_excluded_and_reported_separately fails deterministically on clean master
issue.description:
REPRODUCTION (2026-08-14, workspace sase_12, HEAD 4d5598eaf): tests/llm_provider/test_commit_finalizer_baseline.py::test_pre_existing_sibling_file_is_excluded_and_reported_separately fails deterministically, both on a clean master checkout (verified via git stash) and with the grok_default_pools tale changes applied (unrelated files: model_alias_defaults.yml, docs, and a new test in tests/llm_provider/test_model_alias_defaults.py). Not order-dependent or parallel-lane-only: fails in isolated single-test runs every time.

Traceback: sase.llm_provider.commit_finalizer_types.CommitFinalizerError: Commit finalizer failed: dirty work vanished without an attributable commit. The finalizer will not treat discarded, reset, or foreign-agent work as successful finalization. - core: <tmp>/sase-core_10 (HEAD did not advance) - mine.txt

Raised from _fail_on_discarded_dirty_work in src/sase/llm_provider/commit_finalizer.py:554, called from run_commit_finalizer at commit_finalizer.py:311, via the test's helper run_finalizer in tests/llm_provider/_commit_finalizer_sibling_helpers.py:90.

Recent history on the touched files (git log): 645875d53 "fix(llm_provider): stop attributing pre-existing dirt to the agent" and 21633ba1b "fix: protect dirty work during repo open and finalization" both touch this exact discarded-dirty-work path, so the test's "pre-existing sibling file is excluded" scenario likely regressed against one of those recent changes to _fail_on_discarded_dirty_work / the sibling-repo evidence classification. No related task bead or in-progress epic found via /sase_new_task search (sase-j7's process-global-state-leak epic does not apply: that class is pass-isolation flakes that pass alone under load; this fails deterministically alone).
